abstract.original: The bridge represents a high‐performance molecular network that integrates strong covalent crosslinkes, reversible weak bonds, and dynamic coordination interactions into a unified architecture. Like a well‐designed bridge supporting both structural stability and smooth traffic, this molecular design simultaneously provides mechanical robustness, softness, and efficient ion transport. The flowing ions crossing the bridge symbolize rapid and stable ionic conduction, ultimately leading to durable iontronic sensors and the next generation of wearable electronics, electronic skins, and intelligent robotic systems. image
